mentions.name: smalldocs
mentions.description: An open-source, free-to-use artifact layer for coding agents with a simply styled but functionally deep output format. It combines charts, diagrams, and spreadsheets into a single artifact suitable for creating and optionally sharing agent-generated analysis. Includes a local library for Markdown files plus a paid cloud library, both with tagging and rich search/filtering, turning artifacts into easily revisitable checkpoints in work.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been building https://smalldocs.org, it’s a simply styled, but functionally deep, artifact layer for agents. It’s open source and free to use.

mentions.name: smalldocs
mentions.description: A free, open-source web companion for terminal-based coding agents, described as "Claude Code & Microsoft Office had a baby". It lets developers step out of the terminal view to dig deep into topics while developing with a terminal coding agent, with an analytics view showing usage.
mentions.problem: Developers using a terminal-based coding agent sometimes want to get out of the terminal view to dig deep into a topic.
mentions.audience: Developers working with terminal-based coding agents, described as using it week after week.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on https://smalldocs.org for some time. It as if "Claude Code & Microsoft Office had a baby". It's actually very useful if you develop with a terminal based coding agent and sometimes want to get out of the terminal view to dig deep into a topic.
